data.name: Qaasim
data.gender_notes: Qaasim is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who builds or creates, from the Arabic root q-s-m. The name Qaasim carries the meaning “Builder, Creator” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Qaasim usually hope their child will grow to embody builder, creator and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: One who builds and creates in the spiritual realm.
data.etymology: Qaasim belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Builder, Creator.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Qaasim total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_english.name: Qaasim
in_english.meaning: meaning name Qaasim is a person who distributes among people
in_english.long_meaning: Qaasim is a unique and meaningful name that comes from the Arabic root 'qasama', which means to distribute or share among people. In Islamic tradition, Qaasim is a name that symbolizes a person who is fair, just, and compassionate. It is said that the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) had a companion named Qaasim who was known for his fairness and kindness. In Arabic, the name Qaasim is also associated with the Quranic verse 3:104, which speaks of the importance of treating people with fairness and justice. In modern times, the name Qaasim has gained popularity among Muslims and non-Muslims alike, who appreciate its rich cultural and spiritual significance.

data.cultural_impact: The name Qaasim has historical significance for Muslims, as it is the name of the grandson of Prophet Muhammad PBUH. Qaasim ibn Abil-Asad (s.a.as) was born during the early years of Islam and is considered a close companion of the Prophet. The name carries a sense of heritage and connection to the Prophet's family and the early Islamic community.
data.spiritual_significance: Qaasim is not only a name but also a reminder of the creative power of Allah SWT. In the Islamic worldview, all creation comes from Allah, and we are all His vicegerents, tasked with building and creating in this world. The name Qaasim can serve as a daily reminder to strive for excellence and creativity in our own lives, reflecting the beauty and grace of Allah's creation. It can also inspire us to contribute positively to the world and make a difference in the lives of others.
